module
public import Std.Tactic.BVDecide.LRAT.Checker
import all Std.Tactic.BVDecide.LRAT.Checker
public import Std.Tactic.BVDecide.LRAT.Parser
import all Std.Tactic.BVDecide.LRAT.Internal.CompactLRATChecker
import all Std.Tactic.BVDecide.LRAT.Internal.Convert
import all Std.Tactic.BVDecide.LRAT.Internal.Formula.Implementation
import all Std.Tactic.BVDecide.LRAT.Internal.Formula.Instance
import all Std.Tactic.BVDecide.LRAT.Internal.Actions
@[expose] public section
open Std.Sat Std.Tactic.BVDecide
namespace Spike.Lrat
def cnf : CNF Nat := ⟨#[[(0,true)], [(0,false)]]⟩
def satCnf : CNF Nat := ⟨#[[(0,true)]]⟩
def certificate : Array LRAT.IntAction := #[.addEmpty 3 #[1,2]]
theorem kernelCheck : LRAT.check certificate cnf = true := by decide +kernel
theorem typedUnsat : cnf.Unsat := LRAT.check_sound certificate cnf kernelCheck
theorem nativeCheck : LRAT.check certificate cnf = true := by native_decide
#print axioms kernelCheck
#print axioms typedUnsat
#print axioms nativeCheck
def parseAndCheck (proof : String) (f : CNF Nat) : Except String Bool := do
  let acts ← LRAT.parseLRATProof proof.toUTF8
  return LRAT.check acts f
end Spike.Lrat
